starts.name: town-green
starts.desc: The open green where the roads meet: markets, gossip and a good place to pitch a camp.
starts.label: Town Green

starts.name: shrine-of-luck
starts.desc: A small shrine to Tymora, goddess of luck, cared for by Sister Garaele.
starts.label: Shrine of Luck

starts.name: sister-garaeles-home
starts.desc: Sister Garaele's cottage beside the shrine.
starts.label: Sister Garaele's Home

starts.name: smithy
starts.desc: The town smithy: a forge, tools and a harried smith.
starts.label: Smithy

starts.name: stonehill-inn
starts.desc: A large, newly built roadhouse of fieldstone and timber in the middle of town. Toblen Stonehill keeps it; six rooms for rent.
starts.label: Stonehill Inn

starts.name: barthens-provisions
starts.desc: Barthen's Provisions: the trading post for food, tools and everyday gear.
starts.label: Barthen's Provisions

starts.name: barthens-home
starts.desc: Elmar Barthen's house next to his shop.
starts.label: Barthen's Home

starts.name: sleeping-giant
starts.desc: The Sleeping Giant tap house, a rough place where the Redbrand ruffians drink.
starts.label: Sleeping Giant

starts.name: townmasters-hall
starts.desc: The town master's hall: Harbin Wester's seat of (limited) authority and notice board for jobs.
starts.label: Townmaster's Hall

starts.name: lionshield-coster
starts.desc: The Lionshield Coster: a trading post that sells to caravans on the Triboar Trail.
starts.label: Lionshield Coster

starts.name: phandalin-miners-exchange
starts.desc: The Phandalin Miner's Exchange: a trading post for prospectors, run by Halia Thornton.
starts.label: Phandalin Miner's Exchange

starts.name: woodworker
starts.desc: A woodworker's shop and yard.
starts.label: Woodworker

starts.name: harbin-westers-home
starts.desc: The home of Harbin Wester, the timid town master.
starts.label: Harbin Wester's Home

starts.name: halias-home
starts.desc: Halia Thornton's house, close to the Miner's Exchange.
starts.label: Halia's Home

starts.name: lineness-home
starts.desc: Linene Graywind's home. She runs the Lionshield Coster.
starts.label: Linene's Home

starts.name: edermath-orchard
starts.desc: Daran Edermath's apple orchard and tidy cottage; the retired adventurer lives here.
starts.label: Edermath Orchard

starts.name: alderleaf-farm
starts.desc: Qelline Alderleaf's farm of terraced fields; the halfling will put guests up in her hayloft.
starts.label: Alderleaf Farm

starts.name: tresendar-manor
starts.desc: The ruined Tresendar Manor on the ridge above the gorge: the Redbrands' hideout is under it.
starts.label: Tresendar Manor

starts.name: to-triboar-trail
starts.desc: The road north out of town: it leads to the Triboar Trail.
starts.label: To Triboar Trail

starts.name: miners-trail
starts.desc: The trail leaving the south-west corner of town toward the mines.
starts.label: Miners' Trail
